name: Schlo: Final Stand
source:
Follow T. Chlroid, an insecure genetically engineered human, as he struggles in an attempt to turn his cherished friendship with an important public figure into something else...There is mention of some controversial issues that are not depicted in a favorable light, rather they are issues that can be acknowledged as a part of a society that can be paralleled to reality.
